tweet.text:
Benchmarked my 3 DGX Sparks GLM 5.3 Flash at the settings we actually serve, not just greedy.

Temp 0: 110 tok/s code, 72.6 prose (1 chat)
Our assistant's preset (temp 0.7): 108 code, 66 prose
8 chats at once: 239 → 232 code, 212 → 171 prose

Code barely moves. Prose drops up to 19% at 8 chats, because the draft model's guesses land less often with sampling (68% → 52% accepted).

The CPU sort slowdown others hit on sampled decoding? Didn't show up on 3 ranks.

Benchmark at the settings you serve.
